notes.title: Update Notes July 4th, 2024
notes.content: Fixed controller behavior on Save Load Menu and Reset behavior on Config Menu.

notes.title: How to Fool a Liar King Remastered now supports Turkish!
notes.content:
How to Fool a Liar King Remastered now supports Turkish.
Now you can play the otome game in 8 languages in total.
Simply use the option menu to switch the language you want.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815800/How_to_Fool_a_Liar_King_Remastered/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593430/a12735216415df45d88733e855ebc24baccedb61.jpg[/img]

Again, a lot of thanks for the translator siblings ÖBÖ & RBÖ for providing a great translation for the game!

notes.title: Update Notes January 31, 2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now player can proceed the game with Space bar.
[*] Input Field issue fix: The "OK" button will be selected if player inputted the letter "S" in input field (such as name) because of the primary Unity ADWS setting. This has been fixed now.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For July 25th, 2022
notes.content:
- Fixed movie doesn't play on Linux OS issue.
- Fixed screen tearing/ vsync issue on Full Screen mode.

notes.title: How to Fool a Liar King Remastered now supports Portuguese-Brazil on Steam!
notes.content:
How to Fool a Liar King now supports Portuguese-Brazil. 
You can change the language within the option settings. 
Again, thanks a lot to Rance Guertena for the translation help!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815800/How_to_Fool_a_Liar_King_Remastered/

notes.title: How to Fool a Liar King Remastered is now released on Steam!
notes.content:
The game is now available on Steam and supports 6 languages.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815800/_/

There's also an additional 35% discount for people who has bought the original game.
[b]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25245/How_to_Fool_a_Liar_King_Old_and_New/[/b]
